<function name="GetEntity" parent="DModelPanel" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Returns the entity being rendered by the model panel.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="CSEnt">The rendered entity (client-side)</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Creates an antlion model panel and sets the antlion's skin to 1.</description>
	<code>
BGPanel = vgui.Create("DPanel")
BGPanel:SetPos(20, 20)
BGPanel:SetSize(200, 200)
	
local mdl = vgui.Create("DModelPanel", BGPanel)
mdl:SetSize(200, 200)
mdl:SetModel("models/antlion.mdl")
mdl:SetLookAt(Vector(0, 0, 20))

mdl:GetEntity():SetSkin(1)
	</code>
	<output><image src="DModelPanel_GetEntity_example1.jpg"/></output>

</example>
